changeSet.author: nexus-5xn3k.1
changeSet.comment:
nexus.manifest_verify(p_doc_id text) RETURNS TABLE(referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint) — the per-document anti-join of catalog_document_chunks against the dim-sharded chunks_<dim> tables, aggregated into counts instead of an orphan-row list.
SECURITY INVOKER, tenant-scoped via the nexus.tenant GUC (document_text's pattern, not manifest_orphans' cross-tenant admin pattern) — this is a per-request engine-service read (single-doc verify), called under an established tenant context.
TOMBSTONE-AWARE: a tombstoned parent document (deleted_at IS NOT NULL) is EXCLUDED — its manifest contributes nothing, so referenced=present=missing=0. A soft-deleted document's manifest is not damage.
NULL-COLLECTION CAVEAT: manifest rows with collection IS NULL are pre-backfill state and are excluded from "referenced" entirely (mirrors manifest_orphans' `WHERE c.collection IS NOT NULL` guard) — an un-backfilled document must never read as damaged.
Presence is an OR across chunks_384/768/1024 keyed on (tenant_id, collection, chash) rather than split_part(collection,'__',3) model routing: a given (tenant, collection) pair lives in exactly one dim table by construction, so the OR is equivalent without duplicating the _MODEL_DIMS token list.
Reader contract: no nexus.tenant GUC set -> current_setting(...,true) is NULL -> the doc/manifest CTEs match nothing -> a single row of (0, 0, 0) is returned (aggregates over an empty set, not zero rows). Diverges from purge_trash's RAISE pattern deliberately: readers return nothing/zero, destructive operations raise.
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify(p_doc_id text) RETURNS TABLE( referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ WITH manifest AS ( SELECT c.chash, c.collection FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks c JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = c.doc_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND c.doc_id = p_doc_id AND c.collection IS NOT NULL ), checked AS ( SELECT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_384 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_768 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_1024 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash )) AS is_present FROM manifest m ) SELECT count(*)::bigint AS referenced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present)::bigint AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_present)::bigint AS missing FROM checked $$;

changeSet.author: nexus-5xn3k.1
changeSet.comment:
nexus.manifest_verify_all() RETURNS TABLE(collection text, referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint) — manifest_verify(doc_id) widened to every live document in the caller's tenant, grouped by collection. The doctor verify-sweep primitive (nexus-ac4id part 2): replaces client-side per-collection T3 paging entirely with one engine-side anti-join.
SECURITY INVOKER, tenant-scoped via the nexus.tenant GUC — same reader contract as manifest_verify(text): no GUC set means the manifest CTE matches nothing, so GROUP BY yields zero rows (there is no "total" row; an empty result is the correct "no data / no tenant" answer for a grouped read).
Carries the same two traps as manifest_verify(text): tombstoned parent documents excluded (d.deleted_at IS NULL); collection IS NULL rows excluded from "referenced" (pre-backfill state, not missing).
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify_all() RETURNS TABLE( collection text, referenced bigint, present bigint, missing bigint ) LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY INVOKER AS $$ WITH manifest AS ( SELECT c.chash, c.collection FROM nexus.catalog_document_chunks c JOIN nexus.catalog_documents d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.tumbler = c.doc_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND c.collection IS NOT NULL ), checked AS ( SELECT m.collection, (EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_384 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_768 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nexus.chunks_1024 k WHERE k.tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true) AND k.collection = m.collection AND k.chash = m.chash )) AS is_present FROM manifest m ) SELECT collection, count(*)::bigint AS referenced, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_present)::bigint AS present, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_present)::bigint AS missing FROM checked GROUP BY collection $$;

changeSet.author: nexus-5xn3k.1
changeSet.comment: Grant nexus_svc EXECUTE on manifest_verify/manifest_verify_all — consistent with catalog-004-4's grant pattern for the manifest functions.
changeSet.sql: GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify(text) TO nexus_svc; GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION nexus.manifest_verify_all() TO nexus_svc;
